description: This file is a PHP script that generates and manages the wireless network configuration page for a router or gateway device. It includes PHP code to retrieve current Wi-Fi settings, generate HTML form elements for displaying and editing Wi-Fi parameters, and contains embedded JavaScript for dynamic UI interactions and configuration updates via AJAX. The file handles both 2.4 GHz and 5 GHz wireless interfaces, supporting features like WPS, channel management, security settings, and advanced options.

methods.name: set_config
methods.description: Sends updated wireless configuration settings to the server via AJAX and reloads the page.

methods.name: show_extch
methods.description: Displays the corresponding extension channel options based on selected channel.

methods.name: check_add
methods.description: Validates and prepares data to manually add a MAC address to the control list.

methods.name: adjust_row
methods.description: Re-adjusts the numbering and styling of table rows after modifications.

methods.name: add_row
methods.description: Adds a new entry to either the Wi-Fi control list or auto-learned device list.

methods.name: del_row
methods.description: Deletes a specified row from the control or auto-learned device list.

methods.name: add_auto
methods.description: Copies a row from auto-learned device list to the manual add list.

methods.name: save_filter
methods.description: Saves the MAC filtering rules for a specific SSID.

methods.name: save_config
methods.description: Saves the wireless configuration for a specific radio interface via AJAX.

methods.name: save_enable
methods.description: Enables or disables radio and WPS features and saves the state via AJAX.

methods.name: validChecksum
methods.description: Validates the checksum of a WPS PIN for correctness.

methods.name: pair_client
methods.description: Initiates a WPS pairing process through AJAX.

methods.name: pair_cancel
methods.description: Cancels an ongoing WPS pairing process.
